title: PriceSubmittedEvent
description: Emitted when a source submits a new price for an asset.

asset.description: Stellar contract/account address of the asset (topic).

source.description: Stellar address of the submitting oracle source (topic).

price.description: Raw price value scaled by 10^decimals, encoded as a decimal string (i128).

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) provided by the source.
